note: Small closed classes of nouns and determiners used as evidence cues. These are cues weighed by a policy, never gates: nothing in the core aborts because a form from this file is absent. That is the direct repair of the fixed event-noun prefix inventory that rejected every continuation before the later tests ran (CORE-STATUS F1). The result classes are what separates a checking action from a checking result: occurrence comes from the predicate, result only from a declared result form.

records.note: A trailing space is part of the form where the determiner is written separately, so matching stays character-exact.
A generic head noun can point back without naming the thing. It supports an event link; by itself it never pins entity identity.
A speech noun inside a reporter span makes the scope an attribution rather than a plain report.
A bare title can be a shorter description of a longer named span. Sharing a title is a suffix match, which identity-policy marks insufficient on its own (CONTRACT C2).
A checking clause states a result only when it carries one of these. Bare 확인했다 says a check happened and says nothing about what it found.
The negative counterpart. A negated checking action is not one of these.
Explicit generic happening heads; competing entity mentions prevent a unique event binding.
